contract.description: Verified EVI bundle integrity, compiler status, coverage and inventory.

observations.message: The selected EVI bundle passed the configured evidence verification gate.
Compiler and source-integrity states are reported from the sealed evidence manifest.

contract.description: Cross-layer L5-L12 execution-chain state, command, constraint and output measurements.

observations.message: Common message identities across L5-L12 and per-layer message counts are measured from the evidence index.
Per-layer counts outside the L5-L12 common message intersection are reported without causal interpretation.
For common L5-L12 messages, the first downstream stage with zero motion is counted without assigning cause.

contract.description: L8-L12 safety-path requests, constraints, actuator commands and final safety state.

observations.message: Requested and allowed L9 velocity magnitudes are compared tick by tick.
L12 safety-decision, reason, latch, enable and output counts are reported from normalized evidence.

contract.description: Recovery-related state values and transitions across events/runtime and L5-L12 evidence.

observations.message: Recovery/fault/stop/resume/degraded/active/idle state tokens are counted only on state-bearing fields; configuration and type metadata are excluded.

contract.description: L4-L8 navigation goals, candidates, selections and requested motion distribution.

integrity.digest_scope: all MCAP messages before capture_finalized event

control_phase_timing.note: Code-region elapsed wall time; *_CPU uses time.thread_time_ns. Wall minus thread CPU includes blocking, GIL waits and scheduler preemption; it does not distinguish these causes.

observations.message: L8 requested linear/angular velocities are classified into independent motion-mode and omega-sign distributions by explicit numeric thresholds.
Contiguous non-null L8 stop_reason runs are represented as time-bounded diagnostic episodes.

Explicit source-tick navigation decisions are counted independently of sampled ticks. Candidate rejection, retained map coverage and source sequence discontinuities describe recorded evidence; capture delivery integrity remains the loss authority. Sampled pose is an estimate and this report makes no exact-replay claim.

contract.description: L1-L4 and sensor evidence for pose, heading, odometry, freshness and quality measurements.

observations.message: Localization-related fields are profiled across L1-L4 and localization-relevant materialized sensor views.

contract.description: L8-L12 drive command chain plus wheel/encoder/motor sensor evidence.

observations.message: Wheel-target, normalized-actuator and final-output zero/nonzero/sign relationships are counted independently per layer.

contract.description: Time-linked sampled AMR response, continuity, motion quality and goal progress measurements.

observations.message: Durations use bounded sampled source-time intervals; local-estimate distances and response pairs require unchanged frame/generation and explicit continuity.
L3 is an estimate at tick reference time. Sampling cannot prove between-sample motion, physical tracking, stop distance/settling, or the cause of a skill failure.

Source-time intervals distinguish inactive missions, absent requests, zero allowed motion and final output. Stop episodes remain observable when local pose is unqualified; they do not prove physical stalling or root cause.

Active allowed-motion intervals with qualified stationary L3 estimates are measured with bounded episodes. This sampled relationship does not prove a physical stall, between-sample motion or its cause.

contract.description: L3-L6 world-state, occupancy/obstacle, clearance and local-goal measurements.

observations.message: World-model related fields are profiled across L3-L6; raw-LiDAR materialization is counted without scanning every point.
